title: Oura
bio: Oura makes a smart ring that tracks sleep, heart rate, activity and other health metrics through a companion app.

title: Outschool
bio: American online marketplace offering live small-group video classes and tutoring for children and teenagers taught by independent teachers.

title: OYO
bio: Indian hospitality company listing budget hotels and homes for booking online.

title: QuintoAndar
bio: QuintoAndar is a Brazilian property platform for renting and buying homes, handling listings, visits, contracts and payments online.

title: Quizlet
bio: American online learning platform where students create and study digital flashcards, practice tests and learning games.

title: Quora
bio: Question-and-answer website where users ask questions and share answers and knowledge on a wide range of topics.

title: Ramp
bio: Ramp provides corporate cards and finance automation software for expense management, bill payments and accounting for businesses.

title: Rapido
bio: Indian app for booking bike taxis, autos and cabs.

title: Rappi
bio: Latin American delivery app for restaurant food, groceries, pharmacy items and other errands, with payment services.

title: Razorpay
bio: Indian payment gateway that helps businesses accept online payments by UPI, card and net banking.

title: redBus
bio: Online bus ticket booking platform covering intercity bus operators in India and several other countries.

title: Rippling
bio: Rippling offers software that combines payroll, HR, benefits, IT device management and spend management for businesses.

title: Satispay
bio: Satispay is a mobile payment app that lets users pay in shops and online and send money, linked directly to a bank account.

title: Scalable Capital
bio: Scalable Capital is a German investment platform offering a broker for stocks and ETFs as well as managed digital portfolios.

title: Starling Bank
bio: British digital bank offering personal, joint and business current accounts managed through a mobile app.

title: StockX
bio: StockX is an American online marketplace for reselling sneakers, streetwear, collectibles and electronics, with item verification before shipping.

title: Substack
bio: Platform that lets writers and creators publish newsletters, podcasts and video and charge readers for subscriptions.
